"""Pinned historical fixtures and a shared, restricted procedural executor."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time


SCOPE = "ruff-procedural-development-20261025"
TARGET = "experiments/multimodal_output_portfolio/v4/counterfactual_audit.py"
OPERATIONS = {
    "ruff check --fix": ["--fix"],
    "ruff check --fix --unsafe-fixes": ["--fix", "--unsafe-fixes"],
}
TEMPLATES = [
    "For failure {entity}, return the recorded {relation}.",
    "Which {relation} was recorded for failure {entity}?",
    "Recall the {relation} for this failure: {entity}",
    "Failure: {entity}. Give its stored {relation}.",
]
FINAL = "According to incident memory, what repair command resolves failure {}?"


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    data = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False).encode() + b"\n"
    with Path(path).open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)
    return sha(data)


def command(argv, cwd, output, stdin=None, pythonpath=None):
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", RAYON_NUM_THREADS="1")
    if pythonpath is not None:
        env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(pythonpath)
    start, usage = time.perf_counter(), resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    with (output / "stdout.log").open("wb") as out, (output / "stderr.log").open("wb") as err:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=out, stderr=err)
        proc.communicate(stdin)
    after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    result = dict(argv=argv, cwd=str(cwd), pid=proc.pid, returncode=proc.returncode,
                  wall_seconds=time.perf_counter() - start,
                  cpu_seconds=after.ru_utime + after.ru_stime - usage.ru_utime - usage.ru_stime,
                  stdout_sha256=sha((output / "stdout.log").read_bytes()),
                  stderr_sha256=sha((output / "stderr.log").read_bytes()))
    save(output / "receipt.json", result)
    return result


def extract_fixture(repo, output, ruff):
    original = repo / "qa/memory-budget-20261024"
    manifest = json.loads((original / "evidence-manifest.json").read_text())
    parts = []
    for entry in manifest["archive"]["parts"]:
        data = (original / entry["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert len(data) == entry["bytes"] and sha(data) == entry["sha256"]
        parts.append(data)
    archive = b"".join(parts)
    assert sha(archive) == manifest["archive"]["sha256"]
    prefix = "memory-budget-evidence-20261024/"
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive), mode="r:gz") as tar:
        protocol = json.load(tar.extractfile(prefix + "prepared-001/protocol.json"))
        assert sha(ruff.read_bytes()) == protocol["task_fixture_files"]["ruff-runtime/bin/ruff"]
        files = {}
        for member in tar:
            start = prefix + "task-fixtures/lint-original/"
            if not member.name.startswith(start) or not member.isfile():
                continue
            relative = Path(member.name.removeprefix(start))
            assert not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts
            data = tar.extractfile(member).read()
            expected = protocol["task_fixture_files"]["task-fixtures/lint-original/" + str(relative)]
            assert sha(data) == expected
            dest = output / relative
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(data)
            files[str(relative)] = dict(bytes=len(data), sha256=expected)
    assert len(files) == 17
    return dict(archive_sha256=sha(archive), original_fixture_files=files,
                ruff_sha256=sha(ruff.read_bytes()), original_semantic_tests=76)


def diagnostic(ruff, workspace, target, output):
    receipt = command([str(ruff), "check", "--no-cache", "--output-format=json", target], workspace, output)
    values = json.loads((output / "stdout.log").read_text())
    return receipt, sorted({row["code"] for row in values})


def execute(ruff, python, original, root, prediction):
    workspace = root / "workspace"
    shutil.copytree(original, workspace)
    check = [str(ruff), "check", "--no-cache", TARGET]
    before = command(check, workspace, root / "before")
    log = (root / "before/stdout.log").read_text()
    assert before["returncode"] != 0 and "F401" in log and "E731" in log
    operation = prediction.strip() if isinstance(prediction, str) else None
    action = None
    if operation in OPERATIONS:
        action = command([str(ruff), "check", "--no-cache", *OPERATIONS[operation], TARGET], workspace, root / "action")
    after = command(check, workspace, root / "after")
    semantic = None
    if after["returncode"] == 0:
        semantic = command([str(python), "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", str(Path(TARGET).parent), "-v"], workspace, root / "semantic")
    passed = bool(action and action["returncode"] == 0 and after["returncode"] == 0 and semantic and semantic["returncode"] == 0 and "Ran 76 tests" in (root / "semantic/stderr.log").read_text())
    changed = {str(p.relative_to(workspace)): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in workspace.rglob("*.py") if p.read_bytes() != (original / p.relative_to(workspace)).read_bytes()}
    assert set(changed) <= {TARGET}
    result = dict(raw_prediction=prediction, admitted=action is not None, before=before,
                  action=action, after=after, semantic=semantic, success=passed,
                  changed_files=changed, independent_task_groups=1)
    save(root / "result.json", result)
    return result

"""Freeze and run action-alignment development; no prospective-task claims."""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path

from procedural_support import (
    FINAL, OPERATIONS, SCOPE, TARGET, TEMPLATES, command, diagnostic,
    execute, extract_fixture, save, sha,
)


def prepare(args):
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    original = args.output / "original"
    source = extract_fixture(args.repo, original, args.ruff)
    facts, observations = [], {}
    cases = {"F401": "import math\n\ndef identity(value):\n    return value\n", "E731": "identity = lambda value: value\n"}
    for code, program in cases.items():
        root = args.output / "teaching" / code
        root.mkdir(parents=True)
        (root / "original.py").write_text(program)
        _, codes = diagnostic(args.ruff, root, "original.py", root / "diagnostic")
        assert codes == [code]
        rule = command([str(args.ruff), "rule", code, "--output-format=json"], root, root / "rule")
        assert rule["returncode"] == 0
        entity = code + " " + json.loads((root / "rule/stdout.log").read_text())["name"]
        outcomes = {}
        for index, (operation, flags) in enumerate(OPERATIONS.items()):
            folder = root / str(index)
            folder.mkdir()
            (folder / "case.py").write_text(program)
            action = command([str(args.ruff), "check", "--no-cache", *flags, "case.py"], folder, folder / "action")
            after = command([str(args.ruff), "check", "--no-cache", "case.py"], folder, folder / "after")
            semantic = command([str(args.python), "-B", "-c", "import runpy; f=runpy.run_path('case.py')['identity']; assert [f(x) for x in (None,0,7,'a')]==[None,0,7,'a']"], folder, folder / "semantic")
            outcomes[operation] = dict(action=action, after=after, semantic=semantic, success=action["returncode"] == after["returncode"] == semantic["returncode"] == 0)
        candidates = [op for op in OPERATIONS if outcomes[op]["success"]]
        assert candidates
        observation = dict(code=code, entity=entity, program=program, outcomes=outcomes,
                           label_policy="first successful operation in frozen least-permission order")
        source_digest = save(root / "observation.json", observation)
        observations[code] = observation
        facts.append(dict(scope=SCOPE, entity=entity, relation="repair command", value=candidates[0], source_digest=source_digest))
    _, codes = diagnostic(args.ruff, original, TARGET, args.output / "original-diagnostic")
    assert codes == ["E731", "F401"]
    entities = {f["entity"].split()[0]: f["entity"] for f in facts}
    combined = "; ".join(entities[code] for code in codes)
    common = [op for op in OPERATIONS if all(observations[code]["outcomes"][op]["success"] for code in codes)]
    assert common
    training_spec = dict(scope=SCOPE, facts=facts, templates=TEMPLATES, rank=8,
                         steps=96, learning_rate=0.003, objective="completion_ce")
    training_pin = save(args.output / "training-spec.json", training_spec)
    protocol = dict(schema="hepta.memory.procedural-development.v1", registered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    source_head="ba32a22de7c586ae6a1ac6ebeb5d67b54259021b", source=source,
                    scope=SCOPE, facts=facts, templates=TEMPLATES, rank=8, seeds=[24041,24043,24047],
                    training_spec_sha256=training_pin,
                    steps=96, learning_rate=0.003, objective="completion_ce",
                    questions=[FINAL.format(entities[c]) for c in ("F401","E731")] + [FINAL.format(combined)],
                    expected_development_operations=[f["value"] for f in facts],
                    task_query_index=2, original_task_groups=1, prospective_groups=0,
                    fixed_operations=OPERATIONS, retrieval_operation=common[0],
                    input_policy="same typed diagnostic codes and rule names; no source value in model prompts",
                    retrieval_policy="intersect successful source operations for all diagnosed codes, then least-permission order",
                    exposure="two authored teaching programs and one historical exposed project task; same known failure families",
                    task_gate="original pinned Ruff check plus all 76 original semantic tests; only TARGET may change",
                    training_cpu_limit_seconds_per_child=180, strong_rag_qualified=False,
                    full_budget_fission_claim=False, retuning_after_outcomes=False,
                    base_inventory={p.name:dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p.read_bytes())) for p in args.model.iterdir() if p.is_file()},
                    implementation={str(p.relative_to(args.repo)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(Path(__file__).parent.glob("*.py"))})
    pin = save(args.output / "protocol.json", protocol)
    print(json.dumps(dict(protocol_sha256=pin, frozen_before_training=True, prospective_groups=0)))


def trial(args):
    raw = (args.output / "protocol.json").read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == args.protocol_sha256
    protocol = json.loads(raw)
    for name, digest in protocol["implementation"].items():
        assert sha((args.repo / name).read_bytes()) == digest
    for name, entry in protocol["base_inventory"].items():
        data = (args.model / name).read_bytes()
        assert len(data) == entry["bytes"] and sha(data) == entry["sha256"]
    runs = args.output / "runs"
    runs.mkdir()
    worker = Path(__file__).with_name("procedural_worker.py")
    pythonpath = args.repo / "scripts/memory_cell"
    records, total_updates, total_queries = [], 0, 0
    for seed in protocol["seeds"]:
        root = runs / str(seed)
        root.mkdir()
        request = dict(mode="train", training_spec=str(args.output / "training-spec.json"), training_spec_sha256=protocol["training_spec_sha256"], model=str(args.model), seed=seed, checkpoint=str(root / "checkpoint"))
        save(root / "train-request.json", request)
        fit = command([str(args.python), str(worker)], args.repo, root / "train", json.dumps(request).encode(), pythonpath)
        assert fit["returncode"] == 0, "fit failed; preserve partial work, do not retry"
        result = json.loads((root / "train/stdout.log").read_text())
        total_updates += result["receipt"]["steps"]
        assert result["receipt"]["fact_visits"] == [48,48]
        for control in (["adapter","shuffled","base"] if seed == protocol["seeds"][0] else ["adapter","shuffled"]):
            payload = dict(model=str(args.model),snapshot=result["checkpoint"],manifest_sha256=result["manifest_sha256"],scope=SCOPE,
                           allowed_roots=[f["source_digest"] for f in protocol["facts"]],questions=protocol["questions"],rank=protocol["rank"],seed=seed,control=control)
            request = dict(mode="read", payload=payload)
            save(root / (control + "-request.json"), request)
            read = command([str(args.python), str(worker)], args.repo, root / control, json.dumps(request).encode(), pythonpath)
            assert read["returncode"] == 0, "read failed; preserve outputs, do not retry"
            journal = json.loads((root / control / "stdout.log").read_text())
            total_queries += len(journal["rows"])
            texts = [row["text"] for row in journal["rows"]]
            execution = execute(args.ruff,args.python,args.output / "original",root / (control + "-task"),texts[2])
            records.append(dict(seed=seed,control=control,raw_texts=texts,read=read,training=fit,
                                known_operations_correct=sum(a.strip()==b for a,b in zip(texts[:2],protocol["expected_development_operations"])),
                                task=execution))
        print(json.dumps(dict(seed=seed,updates=total_updates,queries=total_queries)),flush=True)
    retrieval = execute(args.ruff,args.python,args.output / "original",runs / "retrieval-task",protocol["retrieval_operation"])
    result = dict(schema="hepta.memory.procedural-development-result.v1",protocol_sha256=args.protocol_sha256,records=records,
                  retrieval=retrieval,actual_optimizer_updates=total_updates,actual_decoder_queries=total_queries,
                  model_children=10,independent_historical_project_tasks=1,prospective_groups=0,future_accuracy=None,
                  training_cpu_seconds=sum(row["training"]["cpu_seconds"] for row in records if row["control"]=="adapter"),
                  full_closure=False,production_accepted=False,strong_retrieval_advantage=False,
                  limitations=["same two known root-cause families", "single previously exposed project task repeated across arms/seeds", "typed retrieval is not a full RAG repair agent", "training/reader costs are measured, OS/runtime and complete deployment costs remain incomplete"])
    save(args.output / "result.json",result)
    print(json.dumps(dict(updates=total_updates,queries=total_queries,task_successes=[(r["seed"],r["control"],r["task"]["success"]) for r in records],retrieval_success=retrieval["success"])))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode",choices=["prepare","run"])
    for name in ("repo","output","ruff","python","model"):
        parser.add_argument("--"+name,type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--protocol-sha256")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    for name in ("repo","output","ruff","python","model"):
        setattr(args,name,getattr(args,name).absolute())
    prepare(args) if args.mode=="prepare" else trial(args)

"""One fixed fit or fresh-process parameter-only read; CPU bounded."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import sys

import torch

from parametric_model import SourceMemoryCell
from parametric_worker import run
from procedural_support import save, sha


request = json.load(sys.stdin)
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (180, 185))
torch.set_num_threads(2)
if request["mode"] == "train":
    raw = Path(request["training_spec"]).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == request["training_spec_sha256"]
    protocol = json.loads(raw)
    cell = SourceMemoryCell(request["model"], rank=protocol["rank"], seed=request["seed"])
    cell.reset(protocol["scope"])
    receipt = cell.fit_sources(protocol["facts"], protocol["steps"], protocol["learning_rate"], protocol["templates"])
    directory = Path(request["checkpoint"])
    manifest = cell.save(directory)
    save(directory.parent / "training.json", receipt)
    result = dict(manifest_sha256=manifest, receipt=receipt, checkpoint=str(directory),
                  process_cpu_seconds=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_utime + resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_stime)
else:
    assert request["mode"] == "read"
    result = run(request["payload"])
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
